title: Only 6% Of Adults Can Pass This Air Force Entrance Exam
summary: Ten questions test flight principles, instruments, navigation and aviation physics.

landing.intro: The cockpit basics seem easy. Then the exam moves into navigation, controls and flight physics.

about.body:
This ten-question entertainment challenge uses aviation principles that apply across air forces and civil flight worldwide. It moves from the four forces of flight into cockpit instruments, directional language, aircraft controls and basic aerodynamic reasoning.

Choose one answer for each question. Correctness stays hidden until the final reveal, where the complete answer review is available to unlock.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Answer ten increasingly difficult aviation questions.
Choose one of four answers without outside help.
Reveal your score, then unlock every answer you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not an official military recruitment, aptitude, medical or eligibility assessment for any country.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten answers have been checked and your air-power aptitude score is ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Air Power Ace
profile-1.copy: You handled cockpit knowledge, navigation and flight physics with exceptional precision. Almost nothing in this entrance-style exam slowed you down.

profile-2.title: The Flight Operations Standout
profile-2.copy: You passed a challenge that catches out most adults. Your aviation reasoning is strong from the instrument panel to the final physics problem.

profile-3.title: The Aviation Specialist
profile-3.copy: You have a dependable grasp of flight. A few technical controls or physics questions separated your strong result from the pass mark.

profile-4.title: The Ready Cadet
profile-4.copy: The foundations clicked, while specialist navigation and aerodynamic details proved more demanding. The review connects every missing answer.

profile-5.title: The Ground-School Rookie
profile-5.copy: This exam moved quickly into technical territory. Your strongest section shows where your aviation knowledge is ready to take off.

score.passed: You passed the Air Force entrance challenge!

airforce-q1.question: Which of the four forces of flight acts upward against weight?

airforce-q2.question: Which cockpit instrument indicates an aircraft’s altitude?

airforce-q3.question: Which primary flight controls make an aircraft roll?

airforce-q4.question: A magnetic heading of 270 degrees points approximately in which direction?

airforce-q5.question: Mach number compares an aircraft’s speed with what?

airforce-q6.question: In aviation, which side of an aircraft is called port?

airforce-q7.question: A runway numbered 09 is aligned approximately toward which compass direction?

airforce-q8.question: What is the angle between an airfoil’s chord line and the oncoming airflow called?

airforce-q9.question: Jet thrust is explained most directly by which of Newton’s laws?

airforce-q10.question: If air density stays constant and airspeed doubles, dynamic pressure changes by approximately what factor?
